explains.en: A menu board shows the food and drinks you can order.
It is a large display that people can read before ordering.
In a restaurant, it may show meal pictures and prices.

examples.en: The menu board is above the counter.
examples.zh: 菜單看板在櫃檯上方。

examples.en: I look at the menu board before I order.
examples.zh: 我點餐前先看看菜單看板。

examples.en: The menu board shows pictures of burgers.
examples.zh: 菜單看板上有漢堡的圖片。

explains.en: A self-service kiosk is a machine that customers use without a cashier's help.
In a restaurant, you can touch its screen to choose food.
It lets you place your own food order.

examples.en: Dad orders lunch at the self-service kiosk.
examples.zh: 爸爸在自助點餐機上點午餐。

examples.en: The self-service kiosk has a touch screen.
examples.zh: 自助點餐機有觸控螢幕。

examples.en: We choose our drinks on the self-service kiosk.
examples.zh: 我們在自助點餐機上選飲料。

explains.en: A cash register is a machine used to record payments.
It helps a cashier work out how much a customer must pay.
A cash register may have a drawer for keeping money.

examples.en: The cashier stands beside the cash register.
examples.zh: 收銀員站在收銀機旁邊。

examples.en: The cash register has a money drawer.
examples.zh: 收銀機有放錢的抽屜。

examples.en: The cashier uses the cash register to record our payment.
examples.zh: 收銀員用收銀機記錄我們的付款。

explains.en: A dining area is a place where people sit and eat.
In a restaurant, it contains tables and chairs for customers.
It is the part of a restaurant used for enjoying meals.

examples.en: The dining area is bright and tidy.
examples.zh: 用餐區明亮又整潔。

examples.en: We find a table in the dining area.
examples.zh: 我們在用餐區找到一張桌子。

examples.en: The dining area is near the window.
examples.zh: 用餐區在窗戶附近。

explains.en: A cheeseburger is a burger with cheese in it.
It has a meat patty and cheese between pieces of bread.
The cheese is an important part of this kind of burger.

examples.en: I choose a cheeseburger for lunch.
examples.zh: 我選起司漢堡當午餐。

examples.en: The cheeseburger has yellow cheese inside.
examples.zh: 起司漢堡裡面有黃色的起司。

examples.en: She holds a cheeseburger with both hands.
examples.zh: 她用雙手拿著起司漢堡。

explains.en: A Big Mac is a burger sold by McDonald's.
It has two beef patties and an extra piece of bun in the middle.
This burger also contains cheese, lettuce, pickles, onions, and sauce.

examples.en: Dad chooses a Big Mac.
examples.zh: 爸爸選大麥克。

examples.en: The picture shows a Big Mac.
examples.zh: 圖片上有一個大麥克。

examples.en: A Big Mac has an extra piece of bun in the middle.
examples.zh: 大麥克中間多一層漢堡麵包。

explains.en: A chicken burger is a burger made with chicken.
It has cooked chicken between pieces of a bun.
The chicken is the main filling in this kind of burger.

examples.en: I would like a chicken burger.
examples.zh: 我想要一個雞肉漢堡。

examples.en: The chicken burger has lettuce inside.
examples.zh: 雞肉漢堡裡面有生菜。

examples.en: She puts her chicken burger on the tray.
examples.zh: 她把雞肉漢堡放在托盤上。

explains.en: A fish burger is a burger made with fish.
It has cooked fish between pieces of a bun.
The fish is the main filling in this kind of burger.

examples.en: He chooses a fish burger.
examples.zh: 他選魚肉漢堡。

examples.en: The fish burger has sauce inside.
examples.zh: 魚肉漢堡裡面有醬。

examples.en: I put my fish burger on its wrapper.
examples.zh: 我把魚肉漢堡放在它的包裝紙上。

explains.en: Chicken nuggets are small pieces of chicken prepared as bite-sized food.
They are often covered with a crisp coating and cooked.
You can pick up a chicken nugget and dip it into sauce.

examples.en: The chicken nuggets are in a food box.
examples.zh: 雞塊放在餐盒裡。

examples.en: I dip my chicken nuggets into sauce.
examples.zh: 我把雞塊沾進醬裡。

examples.en: We share a box of chicken nuggets.
examples.zh: 我們分享一盒雞塊。

explains.en: A hash brown is a food made from small pieces of potato.
The potato is shaped and cooked until the outside is crisp.
A hash brown can be a flat patty served with breakfast.

examples.en: The hash brown is golden.
examples.zh: 薯餅是金黃色的。

examples.en: Dad puts a hash brown on the tray.
examples.zh: 爸爸把一塊薯餅放在托盤上。

examples.en: I eat a hot hash brown for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃一塊熱薯餅。

explains.en: An apple pie is a pie with an apple filling.
It has apples inside a pastry crust.
Some apple pies are small enough to hold in one hand.

examples.en: The apple pie has apple pieces inside.
examples.zh: 蘋果派裡面有蘋果塊。

examples.en: We share a warm apple pie.
examples.zh: 我們分享一個溫熱的蘋果派。

examples.en: The apple pie is on the tray.
examples.zh: 蘋果派在托盤上。

explains.en: An ice cream cone is ice cream served in a cone-shaped wafer.
You can hold the cone while eating the ice cream.
The cone is a crisp, edible container for the ice cream.

examples.en: She holds an ice cream cone.
examples.zh: 她拿著一支蛋捲冰淇淋。

examples.en: My ice cream cone is cold.
examples.zh: 我的蛋捲冰淇淋是冰的。

examples.en: I eat the ice cream cone before it melts.
examples.zh: 我在蛋捲冰淇淋融化前把它吃完。

explains.en: A sundae is an ice cream dessert with a topping.
It is usually served in a cup or a bowl.
A sundae can have chocolate sauce, fruit, or another topping.

examples.en: The sundae has chocolate sauce on top.
examples.zh: 聖代上面淋著巧克力醬。

examples.en: I eat my sundae with a spoon.
examples.zh: 我用湯匙吃聖代。

examples.en: She chooses a small sundae.
examples.zh: 她選一份小聖代。

explains.en: A soft drink is a drink that does not contain alcohol.
This phrase often means a sweet drink with bubbles, such as cola.
In this lesson, a soft drink means a fizzy drink served with a meal.

examples.en: Dad orders a soft drink.
examples.zh: 爸爸點一杯汽水。

examples.en: The soft drink has ice in it.
examples.zh: 汽水裡有冰塊。

examples.en: I can see bubbles in the soft drink.
examples.zh: 我可以看見汽水裡的氣泡。

explains.en: Orange juice is the liquid taken from oranges.
It is a fruit drink made from oranges.
Orange juice can be served in a glass, a cup, or a carton.

examples.en: She chooses orange juice with her meal.
examples.zh: 她選柳橙汁搭配餐點。

examples.en: The cup is full of orange juice.
examples.zh: 杯子裡裝滿柳橙汁。

examples.en: I drink some cold orange juice.
examples.zh: 我喝一些冰柳橙汁。

explains.en: A Happy Meal is a children's meal sold by McDonald's.
It combines a small main dish with other food and a drink.
A Happy Meal may also include a toy or another item for children.

examples.en: The child chooses a Happy Meal.
examples.zh: 這位小朋友選快樂兒童餐。

examples.en: The Happy Meal comes in a small box.
examples.zh: 快樂兒童餐裝在小餐盒裡。

examples.en: I carry my Happy Meal to the table.
examples.zh: 我把快樂兒童餐帶到桌邊。

explains.en: A wrapper is material used to cover or hold something.
For food, it can be paper wrapped around a burger or another item.
A food wrapper helps keep the food covered before you eat it.

examples.en: The burger is inside its wrapper.
examples.zh: 漢堡包在食物包裝紙裡。

examples.en: I open the wrapper before eating.
examples.zh: 我吃東西前打開食物包裝紙。

examples.en: The wrapper lies under the burger.
examples.zh: 食物包裝紙攤在漢堡下面。

explains.en: A paper bag is a bag made from paper.
It can hold food or other things that you need to carry.
A restaurant may put takeout food in a paper bag.

examples.en: The food is in a paper bag.
examples.zh: 餐點放在紙袋裡。

examples.en: Dad carries the paper bag to the car.
examples.zh: 爸爸把紙袋拿到車上。

examples.en: An empty paper bag stands beside the tray.
examples.zh: 一個空紙袋立在托盤旁邊。

explains.en: A food box is a box used to hold food.
It is a container that helps keep a meal or snack together.
In a restaurant, a food box may hold nuggets or other items.

examples.en: The chicken nuggets are in a food box.
examples.zh: 雞塊放在餐盒裡。

examples.en: I open the food box on the table.
examples.zh: 我在桌上打開餐盒。

examples.en: The empty food box is on my tray.
examples.zh: 空餐盒在我的托盤上。

explains.en: Dipping sauce is a sauce that you dip food into.
It adds flavor when you put a small piece of food into it.
It is often served in a small container beside the food.

examples.en: The dipping sauce is beside the nuggets.
examples.zh: 沾醬放在雞塊旁邊。

examples.en: She dips a nugget into the dipping sauce.
examples.zh: 她把一塊雞塊沾進沾醬。

examples.en: I open the small cup of dipping sauce.
examples.zh: 我打開裝著沾醬的小杯子。

explains.en: A burger bun is the bread used to hold a burger's filling.
It is usually a small round bread roll cut into two parts.
The meat and other fillings go between the parts of the burger bun.

examples.en: The burger bun is round and soft.
examples.zh: 漢堡麵包圓圓又軟軟的。

examples.en: I lift the top of the burger bun.
examples.zh: 我掀開漢堡麵包的上半部。

examples.en: There is cheese under the burger bun.
examples.zh: 漢堡麵包下面有起司。

explains.en: A recycling bin is a container for materials collected for recycling.
People put accepted recyclable items in this bin.
Its sign or pictures tell you what can go inside.

examples.en: The recycling bin has a symbol on it.
examples.zh: 資源回收桶上有一個標誌。

examples.en: We check the pictures above the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 我們查看資源回收桶上方的圖片。

examples.en: The recycling bin is beside the trash can.
examples.zh: 資源回收桶在垃圾桶旁邊。

explains.en: A tray return station is a place where customers return used trays.
It may have a rack or a shelf for stacking trays.
Restaurants use this area to collect trays after meals.

examples.en: Dad takes our tray to the tray return station.
examples.zh: 爸爸把我們的托盤拿到餐盤回收區。

examples.en: The tray return station is near the exit.
examples.zh: 餐盤回收區在出口附近。

examples.en: We leave the tray at the tray return station.
examples.zh: 我們把托盤放在餐盤回收區。

explains.en: Leftovers are food that remains after a meal.
They are parts of a meal that people have not eaten.
Some leftovers can be kept and eaten later if stored safely.

examples.en: There are some leftovers on the tray.
examples.zh: 托盤上有一些剩餘食物。

examples.en: Dad puts the leftovers in a box.
examples.zh: 爸爸把剩餘食物放進餐盒。

examples.en: We take our leftovers home.
examples.zh: 我們把剩餘食物帶回家。

explains.en: An empty cup is a cup with nothing inside it.
It is a cup that no longer holds a drink or other contents.
After finishing a drink, you may have an empty cup.

examples.en: The empty cup is beside the tray.
examples.zh: 空杯子在托盤旁邊。

examples.en: I take the lid off the empty cup.
examples.zh: 我拿下空杯子的杯蓋。

examples.en: We can see inside the empty cup.
examples.zh: 我們可以看見空杯子的內部。

explains.en: A paper wrapper is paper used to cover or hold something.
For food, it is paper wrapped around an item such as a burger.
It serves the same purpose as other food wrappers but is made of paper.

examples.en: The burger has a paper wrapper.
examples.zh: 漢堡包著食物包裝紙。

examples.en: I open the paper wrapper on the table.
examples.zh: 我在桌上打開食物包裝紙。

examples.en: The used paper wrapper is on the tray.
examples.zh: 用過的食物包裝紙在托盤上。

explains.en: A used napkin is a napkin that someone has already used.
It may have been used to wipe a mouth, hands, or a small spill.
It can have food marks or moisture after use.

examples.en: The used napkin is beside the empty cup.
examples.zh: 使用過的餐巾紙放在空杯子旁邊。

examples.en: I put the used napkin on the tray.
examples.zh: 我把使用過的餐巾紙放在托盤上。

examples.en: The used napkin has a small sauce mark.
examples.zh: 使用過的餐巾紙上有一小塊醬漬。

explains.en: A cleaning cloth is a piece of cloth used to clean surfaces.
People use it to wipe tables or remove small spills.
A cleaning cloth may be damp when someone uses it.

examples.en: The employee wipes the table with a cleaning cloth.
examples.zh: 店員用清潔抹布擦桌子。

examples.en: The cleaning cloth is wet.
examples.zh: 清潔抹布是濕的。

examples.en: The cleaning cloth is on the cart.
examples.zh: 清潔抹布放在推車上。

explains.en: A dustpan is a small tool used to collect dirt from a floor.
You sweep dirt into it with a broom.
Its flat edge helps it sit close to the floor.

examples.en: The dustpan is beside the broom.
examples.zh: 畚箕在掃把旁邊。

examples.en: The employee sweeps dirt into the dustpan.
examples.zh: 店員把灰塵掃進畚箕。

examples.en: The dustpan is on the cleaning cart.
examples.zh: 畚箕放在清潔推車上。

explains.en: A cleaning cart is a cart used to carry cleaning supplies.
It has wheels so a worker can move tools from place to place.
It may hold cloths, bags, and other cleaning equipment.

examples.en: The cleaning cart is near the table.
examples.zh: 清潔推車在桌子附近。

examples.en: The employee pushes the cleaning cart.
examples.zh: 店員推著清潔推車。

examples.en: A cleaning cloth rests on the cleaning cart.
examples.zh: 一塊清潔抹布放在清潔推車上。

explains.en: A trash bag is a bag used to collect trash.
It can fit inside a trash can and hold waste.
A filled trash bag can be tied closed for removal.

examples.en: The trash bag is inside the trash can.
examples.zh: 垃圾袋放在垃圾桶裡。

examples.en: The employee ties the trash bag closed.
examples.zh: 店員把垃圾袋綁好。

examples.en: A tied trash bag is beside the cleaning cart.
examples.zh: 一個紮好的垃圾袋在清潔推車旁邊。

explains.en: A recycling symbol is a sign connected with recycling.
A common version has three arrows that form a loop.
It helps people recognize recycling information or a recycling area.

examples.en: The recycling symbol is on the bin.
examples.zh: 回收標誌在桶子上。

examples.en: The child points to the recycling symbol.
examples.zh: 小朋友指著回收標誌。

examples.en: The recycling symbol has three arrows.
examples.zh: 回收標誌有三個箭頭。

explains.en: An exit sign is a sign that shows the way to an exit.
It helps people find a door or route leading out.
It may use words, an arrow, or a picture of a person leaving.

examples.en: The exit sign is above the door.
examples.zh: 出口指示牌在門上方。

examples.en: We look for the exit sign.
examples.zh: 我們找出口指示牌。

examples.en: The exit sign points toward the door.
examples.zh: 出口指示牌指向門口。

explains.en: A combo meal is a group of food items sold together as one meal.
It often includes a main dish, a side dish, and a drink.
You order the items as a set rather than choosing each one separately.

examples.en: The combo meal has a burger, fries, and a drink.
examples.zh: 套餐有漢堡、薯條和飲料。

examples.en: Dad orders a combo meal.
examples.zh: 爸爸點一份套餐。

examples.en: The combo meal is on one tray.
examples.zh: 套餐放在同一個托盤上。

explains.en: À la carte describes food items ordered separately from a menu.
An à la carte menu lets you choose individual items instead of a set meal.
As an adverb, à la carte means ordering items separately, each with its own price.

examples.en: The à la carte menu shows separate food items.
examples.zh: 單點菜單列出個別餐點。

examples.en: We order our burgers à la carte.
examples.zh: 我們以單點方式點漢堡。

examples.en: Dad chooses an à la carte burger instead of a combo meal.
examples.zh: 爸爸選單點漢堡，沒有選套餐。

explains.en: Dine-in describes eating at the restaurant where you order your food.
Dine-in service provides food for customers who stay and eat there.
Dine-in customers use the restaurant's tables instead of taking the meal away.

examples.en: Dine-in customers sit in the dining area.
examples.zh: 內用顧客坐在用餐區。

examples.en: The restaurant offers dine-in service.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳提供內用服務。

examples.en: Our dine-in meal comes on a tray.
examples.zh: 我們的內用餐點放在托盤上。

explains.en: Takeout is food prepared by a restaurant to be eaten somewhere else.
You collect takeout and carry it away from the restaurant.
In American English, takeout can mean a meal that you bring home.

examples.en: Dad picks up our takeout.
examples.zh: 爸爸領取我們的外帶餐點。

examples.en: The takeout is in a paper bag.
examples.zh: 外帶餐點放在紙袋裡。

examples.en: We carry the takeout home.
examples.zh: 我們把外帶餐點帶回家。
